t: Expansion boxes can be attached to advanced beehives to increase the bee capacity of the hive from 3 to 5. Expansion boxes can be placed on top of or next to the hive. Each hive can only have one expansion box.
扩容盒可以安装在高级蜂箱上，将蜂箱的蜜蜂容量从 3 提升到 5。扩容盒可以放在蜂箱顶部或侧面。每个蜂箱只能安装一个扩容盒。
